tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A warm paper white in light, a deep forest in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on paper. Large radii, no shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text. 14.0:1 on paper (light), 15.2:1 on paper (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions. 5.7:1 on paper (light), 8.3:1 on paper (dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers only. Decorative: controls need ink or a fill to read.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any fill below. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The signature and primary action: the main button, the active state, a completed ring. On-bright text 6.8:1.

tokens.name: pulse-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text and links, for completion and selected states. 5.0:1 on paper (light), 9.7:1 on paper (dark).

tokens.name: breath
tokens.usage: The Breath zone: breathing, ribcage, exhale. Fills and illustration only. On-bright text 8.4:1.

tokens.name: balance
tokens.usage: The Balance zone: standing, weight shift, stillness. Fills and illustration only. On-bright text 5.6:1.

tokens.name: reach
tokens.usage: The Reach zone: arms, hands, stretching, grip. Fills and illustration only. On-bright text 6.3:1.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The Ground zone: feet, floor contact, legs. Fills and illustration only. On-bright text 8.4:1.

tokens.name: rest
tokens.usage: The Rest zone: wind-down, sleep, release. Fills and illustration only. On-bright text 5.8:1.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: A gentle pause, a suggestion to slow down or to check in with a therapist. Not an error red. 5.9:1 on paper (light), 10.0:1 on paper (dark).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight pairs: icon and label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Standard inner padding and gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gutter between blocks and cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen. Room for the body to move.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inputs and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List items and small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and large shapes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All buttons, chips, progress bars and the logo's dot.
